text:
ela: Heads-up: found a keyboard/sr annoyance in the org settings invite card (compact). Tab order hits avatar -> project name -> role chip -> invite CTA -> kebab. For keyboard-first users the primary action (Invite) should come earlier. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/invite-card-compact-v2.png
rachel: Thanks. Do we have the DOM today? visual order uses flex to show role on left and actions on right on narrow widths.
piyush: Current DOM: avatar, heading, role-chip, actions(invite, more). So DOM follows visual order because of flex-reverse.
jory: Two fixes: 1) reorder DOM so Invite sits right after heading, then role-chip; 2) keep visual layout by CSS grid placement. Reordering DOM is the most SR-friendly.
ela: Agreed but note CSS focus styles assume previous DOM; will need to ensure :focus-visible still matches.
rachel: Copy suggestion for screen readers: change invite button aria-label to "Invite people to Project Z" instead of just "Invite". And role chip SR text should be concise ("Developer role" instead of "Role: Developer - editable").
piyush: Implementation note: moving elements in DOM might affect surrounding layout and micro-interactions. Alternative: keep DOM as-is but use an offscreen button (sr-only) placed after heading that triggers same invite flow, then hide visual invite button but keep it tabbable? bit hacky.
jory: Don't recommend hidden duplicates. Better to change DOM order and fix styling. It's cleaner and easier to test.
ela: Accessibility checklist proposal from me: 1) DOM order: heading -> invite button -> role chip -> kebab 2) invite aria-label: "Invite people to Project Z" 3) role chip aria-label: "Developer role" 4) ensure kebab is last in tab order 5) role chip contrast >= 4.5:1 when interactive
a11y-bot: Quick audit: also ensure button has descriptive aria-describedby when role already exists (e.g., "Invite — assigns Developer role") but keep that sr-only. Verify with NVDA/VO.
rachel: Small copy tweak: make the SR description "Invite — assigns ‘Developer’ role" (quotes help clarity).
piyush: I'll update CSS and add a11y unit tests for tab order and aria labels. Might need a tiny refactor of Tile component props.
ela: Can we get a small prototype in the beta branch this sprint? We should show VoiceOver and NVDA notes at design review.
jory: I'll own the PR, will attach before/after keyboard walkthrough GIFs.
a11y-bot: Reminders: 1) preserve focus rings; 2) test with reduced motion; 3) run axe-core on the component; 4) ensure role chip focusable states don't confuse SR users.
ela: Thanks all. tagging @rachel for final copy ok before I merge. :sparkles:
